blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – As the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) transitions from an interim regional government to a regular parliament, the Bangsamoro Transition Authority (BTA) said it has enacted 94 laws since 2019. The BTA Media Affairs Office said Tuesday the 94 Bangsamoro Autonomy Acts (BAAs) have provided the legal framework for the region’s establishment, operation, and development. The laws cover areas of governance, public administration, education, health, social protection, human rights, local government, electoral affairs, public finance, culture, and other matters within the region’s autonomous powers.
